The wrapper bootstrap JAR comes from Gradle's official `v4.10.3` tag
(https://github.com/gradle/gradle/blob/v4.10.3/gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar).
It supports Java 8 and SHA-256 distribution verification, and launches **Gradle
2.14.1** as pinned in `gradle-wrapper.properties`. The Gradle runtime remains
2.14.1 for ForgeGradle 2.1 compatibility. The launcher scripts were generated by
Gradle 2.14.1. Do not replace the distribution checksum to bypass verification.
